Social Rank is PageRank on the signed popularity network, with weights
$a_{ij} = P^+_{ij} - P^-_{ij} + 1$ (see `code/01_build_measures.R`). This
notebook documents that coding, compares it with alternative constructions,
and relates it to other student characteristics.
Code: `code/si/S4_social_rank.R`.

```{r s4-setup}
```

```{r s4-coding}
```

The $+1$ shift adds the same constant ($N-1$) to every child's incoming
weight, so before PageRank the ordering is exactly the ordering by net
nominations:

```{r s4-incoming-weight}
```
